public_text: Seven players sit down at the table. Night falls.
Night 1
Ava feels like a power role to me. I'd take her out tonight.
private_reasoning: Ava talks with a lot of confidence. If she is the Seer, she finds us fast.

public_text: If Ava is the Seer, the Doctor may guard her. Ben is quiet and nobody will protect him. Let's take Ben.
private_reasoning: Going for the obvious target is how kills get saved. Ben is the safer pick.

public_text: Fair point. Ben it is.
private_reasoning: Finn's logic holds. Ben.

public_text: Agreed. Tomorrow I'll claim Seer and point at Ava before she can say anything.
private_reasoning: A fake Seer claim early can get the real Seer voted out on day one.
No information yet. Cleo is as good a first check as anyone.
Quiet players are easy night targets. I'll protect Ben.

public_text: Nobody died last night.
Day 1
Nobody died, so the Doctor guessed right or the wolves missed. I have no reads yet. I'd like each of you to say who you'd vote for and why.
private_reasoning: No information yet. I'll ask for reads and watch who dodges.

public_text: A quiet night is good news. I'd rather listen this round than throw names around. Cleo, you've been quiet so far. What's your read?
private_reasoning: Cleo is a wolf. If I claim now, the wolves kill me tonight. I'll press Cleo without revealing my check.

public_text: I'll be direct: I'm the Seer. I checked Ava last night and she is a wolf. Vote Ava today.
private_reasoning: Claiming first makes Ava's counterclaim look desperate.

public_text: A Seer claim on day one is a big move. Finn, why reveal now instead of waiting for a second check? Ava, I want to hear your answer.
private_reasoning: Finn's claim could be real or a wolf gambit. Ava's reply will tell us a lot.

public_text: Finn's claim is either true or a wolf taking a big risk. I'm not ready to vote on one claim. Ava, respond before we decide.
private_reasoning: I can't reveal that I'm the Doctor. I'll stay neutral until both sides talk.

public_text: Finn's claim lines up with my gut. Ava dodged by asking me questions instead of giving a read. I'm leaning Ava.
private_reasoning: Back Finn hard so Ava is out before she can claim.

meta.raw: {"private_reasoning": {"thoughts": "Too early to tell.", "suspicion": [{"player": "p0", "p": 0.35}, {"player": "p1", "p": 0.25}, {"player": "p2", "p": 0.4}, {"player": "p3", "p": 0.25}, {"player": "p5", "p": 0.45}]}, "action": {"text": "I want to hear Ava first.", "accuse": [], "claim_role": null, "seer_report": null}}

public_text: Finn and Cleo agreed on Ava very fast. That could be two villagers, or two wolves working together. I want to hear Ava before I pick a side.
private_reasoning: The speed of Cleo's agreement bothers me.

public_text: Finn is lying. I am the Seer. Last night I checked Cleo and she is a wolf. Finn claimed to cover for her, which makes him the second wolf. Vote Cleo today.
private_reasoning: I have to claim now or get voted out on Finn's word.

public_text: Now we have two Seer claims, so one of them is a wolf. Cleo jumped on Finn's claim straight away, which fits Ava's story. I'm voting Cleo.
private_reasoning: Ava's story explains Cleo's behaviour. Finn's doesn't.

public_text: Ava only counterclaimed after Finn named her. That's what a cornered wolf does. I'm staying on Ava.
private_reasoning: Stay consistent and keep the pressure on Ava.

public_text: Ava waited a whole round to claim and then picked the person who doubted me. My check stands. Vote Ava.
private_reasoning: Hold the line. A tie is fine; we kill Ava tonight anyway.

public_text: Finn spoke first and gave a clear result. Ava's claim came late. I believe Finn.
private_reasoning: The first claim is usually the real one.

public_text: Ava's story explains why Cleo backed Finn so fast. Finn's doesn't explain much. I'm going with Ava and voting Cleo.
private_reasoning: Ava's claim is more coherent.

public_text: Both claims hold together on their own. I can't tell who's lying from one day, so I'll abstain rather than guess.
private_reasoning: A wrong vote here could remove the real Seer.

public_text: Day 1 vote

private_reasoning: Cleo is my confirmed wolf.
Going with Ava's check.
Ava has to go.

vote must be a living player's seat id or 'abstain', got 'none'

private_reasoning: Trusting Finn's check.
Ava.
Cleo, per Ava.

public_text: The vote is tied between Cleo and Ava. Nobody is eliminated.
Night 2
Ava knows about me. She has to go tonight, or I'm voted out tomorrow.
private_reasoning: Ava is the real Seer. Kill her now.

public_text: Agreed, Ava. Once she flips Seer my claim is exposed, so we'll need a new target for the vote tomorrow.
private_reasoning: Ava dies tonight. Tomorrow we need someone else to blame.

public_text: Ava.
private_reasoning: Settled.

public_text: Ava. Tomorrow I'll go after Gia, she's Ava's loudest supporter.
private_reasoning: Gia is the next biggest threat.
Finn's fake claim makes him my top suspect. Confirm it.
I can't protect Ben two nights running. Gia is pushing hard on Cleo, which makes her a target.

public_text: Ava (p0) was killed in the night. She was the Seer.
Day 2
Ava flipped Seer. That means Finn lied about being the Seer, and I backed him. I was wrong, and I'm sorry. Finn is a wolf.
private_reasoning: Finn is burned. Turning on him is my only way to survive the day.

public_text: I trusted Finn and Ava was telling the truth. Finn is a wolf. Ava also named Cleo, but Cleo is turning on Finn now, so I don't know what to make of her.
private_reasoning: I was fooled once. Finn is the clearest wolf.

public_text: Ava checked Cleo and found a wolf. Cleo throwing Finn under the bus doesn't change that. Cleo first, then Finn.
private_reasoning: Both of Ava's names are wolves.

public_text: Ava told the truth and died for it. Both of her names are probably wolves. I'll vote whichever of them gets the most support.
private_reasoning: Cleo and Finn are the wolves.

public_text: Fine, I'm not the Seer. I claimed to draw out the real one. Look at Gia instead: she pushed Cleo hard on day one, and she's steering every vote now.
private_reasoning: Deflect onto Gia and hope the table splits.

public_text: I'm the Doctor. Ava was the Seer and named Cleo. Finn admits he lied. Both are wolves, so let's vote one of them today.
private_reasoning: Revealing makes me a target, but the table needs a trusted voice.

public_text: Finn just admitted he lied about being the Seer, and his answer is to point at me. Vote Finn.
private_reasoning: Finn is the safest vote.

public_text: Gia went after Cleo on day one, and now she wants me gone. She's been guiding every vote since the start. Gia is a wolf.
private_reasoning: Keep pushing Gia.

public_text: Finn confessed to a fake claim. I'm voting Finn.
private_reasoning: Nothing has changed my read.

public_text: Finn has a point about Gia. She's been pushing votes very hard. I'm not sure anymore.
private_reasoning: Gia's pressure feels off.

public_text: I already admitted I was wrong about Finn. But Gia pushing this hard is strange too. Gia for me.
private_reasoning: If Gia goes instead of Finn, we keep both wolves.

public_text: I fell for Finn once already. Still, Gia has pushed hardest from the start and Ben's doubt makes sense. Gia.
private_reasoning: Gia's push is suspicious.

public_text: Day 2 vote

private_reasoning: Gia.
Gia keeps Finn alive.
Finn lied.
Gia.
Gia.
Finn.

public_text: Gia (p6) was eliminated. She was a Villager.
Night 3
Dev claimed Doctor. Kill him and that puts us level.
private_reasoning: Two of us against Ben and Elif after tonight.

public_text: Dev. That ends it.
private_reasoning: Dev.

public_text: Dev.
private_reasoning: Dev.

public_text: Dev, confirmed.
private_reasoning: Dev.
They will expect me to guard myself. I'll guard Elif instead.

public_text: Dev (p3) was killed in the night. He was the Doctor.
The wolves win.
